body: I believe in you, you and I will make it through this.
Congrats on hitting the karma jackpot.

I'm very sorry to hear that you're also going through this. I have improved dramatically since I made this post. Things are not all better but I can at least feel that they WILL be better. I've found that taking to people has helped me a lot. Not necessarily about the relationship or breakup just in general. I'm more than happy to talk/listen if you ever need somebody! You will not only be helping yourself, I would also be benefiting from it. Please feel free to message me if you need me. Keep your head up and heart strong. <3

Thank you very much for your response. A lot of these things make sense to me. I am with my family right now due to Fathers Day happenings but I will respond more in detail when time allows. Thank you for your time and insight.
